title: Maximum Product Subarray
description: Given an integer array `nums`, find a non-empty contiguous subarray with the largest product and return that product. A subarray must contain consecutive elements.
constraints: The product of every contiguous subarray fits in a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: A negative value can turn the smallest product so far into the largest.
Track both the maximum and minimum product ending at the current position.

examples.explanation: The subarray [2, 3] has product 6, which is maximal.
